invariants.text: Customer.customer_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Room.room_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Reservation.reservation_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Reservation.customer_id must reference an existing Customer.customer_id
Reservation.room_id must reference an existing Room.room_id
A reservation must not overlap with an existing reservation for the same room.
If a reservation starts on or after the end date of an existing reservation in the same room, it does not overlap.
If a reservation ends on or before the start date of an existing reservation in the same room, it does not overlap.
A room cannot have two reservations that occupy the same time interval.
A reservation is rejected if its start date is before the end date of another reservation in the same room.
A reservation is rejected if its end date is before the start date of another reservation in the same room.
A reservation is rejected if it overlaps with any other reservation in the same room, regardless of start or end date.
